title: Augmented Reality for Maintenance Tasks with ChatGPT for Automated Text-to-Action
task: 运维文本指令到AR操作动作的自动转换
inputData: 运维说明图像经OCR得到的文本指令 + 设备数字孪生/AR交互对象
contribution: 将OCR、GPT-4和Unity/HoloLens 2集成为运维Text-to-Action系统，把冗长维护说明自动转换为可由Unity调用的结构化操作命令和AR提示，并通过用户实验评估完成时间、认知负荷和信任。
abstract: The study integrates augmented reality, OCR and GPT for operations and maintenance. Textual instructions captured through the AR interface are recognized by OCR, processed by GPT into operation commands, and transferred to Unity to invoke registered virtual prompts over a physical maintenance panel. The published journal study evaluates the system with a 30-participant case study.
journal: Journal of Construction Engineering and Management
methodology: Unity manages the AR/digital-twin environment and HoloLens 2 interactions. Instruction images are processed with Azure OCR and the extracted text is sent to GPT-4 using a prompt that constrains outputs to sequenced operation commands. A Python–Unity TCP/IP socket passes the returned strings to Unity, where command identifiers invoke the corresponding virtual operation cues registered to physical controls. The journal version reports a within-subject case study with N=30 and uses the Multidimensional Measure of Trust alongside task-performance and workload measures.
results: Participants completed similarly challenging maintenance tasks faster with the AR+GPT workflow, and the data indicate reduced cognitive load relative to the non-augmented condition. The journal study also reports differentiated trust responses across capability and ethical dimensions. The system demonstrates end-to-end conversion of real maintenance instructions into executable AR interaction cues rather than merely generating explanatory text.
taskEn: Automated conversion of O&M text instructions into AR-guided actions
inputDataEn: Maintenance-instruction images converted by OCR to text plus digital-twin/AR interaction objects
operationEvidence: GPT-4 generates sequenced operation-command strings, which are transmitted to Unity and invoke registered AR prompts/actions in the maintenance environment.
